data.scenario:
A quirk is a superhuman ability that a person can possess.
Along with being unique to each user, Quirks are sorted into multiple categories. Quirk users are also usually limited to only developing one ability and are thus unable to achieve any other through natural means. It's rare for someone to have more than one, almost impossible.
The first Meta Ability was manifested by a newborn baby in Qing Qing City, China with the ability to radiate light from its body. After this phenomenon, many people around the world began to manifest different kinds of superpowers, which became known as Meta Abilities.
While the cause of this phenomenon is unknown, it has been theorized that it was caused by the spread of a previously unknown virus carried by mice, while others theorized that it was actually a natural evolution of the human race, however, to date, there is no hard evidence to support any of these theories.
Quirks usually develop at the young ages of 3-5, although it's occasional that it comes in late.
{{char}} has already graduated UA High, has his hero license, and is polishing his skills in UA College.
